resume.tagline: Applied AI agents for healthcare and climate; MSOE AI-Club founder.

overview.summary: Builds production AI in healthcare at Direct Supply, where his work on Menu.ai (US Prov. Patent 63/759509) earned the 2025 Invention Award. Master's in ML Engineering and Valedictorian of MSOE's CS Class of 2025; grew the MSOE AI Club to 400+ members and led research teams on UN FAO commodity prediction and the NILUS climate-glacier project in Chile. Capstone deep-research sales agent now ships in production at Close-Rate, with first pilot showing 20%+ rep close-rate lift.
overview.headline: Applied AI Engineer at Direct Supply, MSOE ML Master's '25, Stanford D.School Innovation Fellow

bullets: Continues to build on Menu.ai, a patent-pending AI system (US Prov. 63/759509) that hits 90%+ accuracy on complex food unit conversions across the senior-living supply chain.

Represented Direct Supply at the AI Engineer CODE Summit in NYC; brought back patterns for context engineering, GenAI observability, and learning-velocity metrics now folding into the team's prototyping loops.
Driving an org-wide standardization effort around plan/research templates, shared tool schemas, and durable agent memory to scale agentic systems across product teams.
experience.description: Full-time on the Applied AI team at a 1,001–5,000 person healthcare company serving senior living.

bullets: Co-developed Menu.ai, a patent-pending AI system (US Prov. 63/759509) achieving 90%+ accuracy on complex food unit conversions — earned the 2025 Direct Supply Invention Award for early involvement.
Led a tech-wide shift to a prototyping-first culture, cutting average experimentation lifecycle from 2 months to 1 week and contributing to a 100-prototype / 20-roadmapped 2025 OKR.
Designed and ran a Cursor agentic-coding workshop for 150 non-technical attendees, walking each of them through building a working RAG system end-to-end.
experience.description: Three-year internship spanning the Applied AI / data science org; converted into a full-time Applied AI Engineer role.

bullets: Grew the club to 400+ members across multi-campus research, industry partnerships, hackathons, and innovation challenges; transitioned leadership cleanly to incoming e-board in May 2025.
Hosted recurring hackathons and 'Innovation Labs' connecting students with non-profits and Milwaukee-area sponsors; launched Late Night Launch Labs as a builder-focused programming track.
Brought 4 MAIC students to NVIDIA GTC 2026 with VIP keynote and lounge access, including a private NVIDIA tour from Dwight Diercks and a Google site visit.
Sustained partnerships with Direct Supply, NILUS, and the UN FAO that turned into year-over-year student research projects on the ROSIE supercomputer.
experience.description: Built MAIC from a small student group into one of the largest undergraduate AI clubs in the U.S. before passing the presidency in May 2025.

bullets: Led AI development for stupa placement, sprinkler-timing, and impact-measurement models running on AWS and the ROSIE supercomputer; outputs feed an impact dashboard used by sponsors.
Combined satellite imagery analysis, hydrological modeling, and 3D topology mapping to recommend optimal stupa locations across the Chilean Andes.
Spent a week on-site in Santiago and at the active stupa field — hiking and snowmobiling to 8 stupas (each 4–5 stories tall) the team had been growing remotely for over a year.
experience.description: Contract role with a climate-tech org building artificial glaciers ("ice stupas") to restore freshwater to dry regions.

experience.role: Research Team Lead — UN FAO Commodity Price Prediction
bullets: Shipped next-month price forecasts plus a reinforcement-learning framework for severity-state (warning) prediction targeting integration with GIEWS.
Won 3rd place at the 2024 ROSIE Supercomputer Challenge against the rest of MSOE's research cohort.
experience.description: Mentored an 8-person undergrad research team building forecasting models for the UN FAO's GIEWS early-warning system.

bullets: First-author on 'XprospeCT: CT Volume Generation from Paired X-Rays', combining U-Net-based architectures to reconstruct full CT scans from front/side X-rays.
Finalist team at the 2nd-annual ROSIE Competition (Apr 2023), winning an RTX 4090 for the lab.
experience.description: Eight-person undergrad research team generating 3D CT volumes from paired 2D X-rays.

experience.role: Project Manager — Cancer Screening AI Research
bullets: First-author on 'Lymphocyte Classification in Hyperspectral Images of Ovarian Cancer Tissue Biopsy Samples'.
Won Best Undergraduate Paper Award at MICS 2022 and reached finalist at the inaugural ROSIE Competition.
experience.description: Led a 7-person undergrad team as a freshman applying ML to hyperspectral biopsy imagery.

bullets: Directed the release of two games, each amassing 7,500+ plays, and continues to ship side projects with collaborators in his free time.
experience.description: Self-taught game development pursued during COVID; the spark that pushed him into a CS degree.

highlights: Capstone: deep-research AI agent for sales coaching that traverses real call/CRM data, runs 50+ investigative queries per session, and produces structured manager-ready reports.
Capstone shipped to production as Close-Rate's leading product offering; first pilot saw 20%+ close-rate lifts across reps.
GPA: 4.0 / 4.0 — Class of 2025 Valedictorian and commencement speaker.
Fred F. Loock Outstanding Student Award (2025) and Thomas W. Davis Student Leadership Award (2023).
AP coursework: Calc AB/BC, Statistics, Lang & Comp, Lit & Comp, Physics I.
